p.i: Qua causa melle ut dulcius id putet,
Quod felle quo uis sentit amarius?

page.notes: The text is set in a small italic type with some worn letters. Doubtful readings: "fáfne" (possibly "sasne" or "fasne") and "speras" (possibly "sperat") are uncertain. "Censetue" is a doubtful reading for "Censetne". The line "Qua fronte quod prauum videbit" is partly worn. The left margin shows a few spots, and the text near the foot of the page is unclear, but no printed matter is lost. Headings 5 and 6 are italic section numbers with an ordinary text line, so they are shown as level 2 heads.
